_comment: Perf bars for the NODE email-triage SDK (hub/agents/email/node). Loaded by gaia.eval.benchmark.default_perf_thresholds_path('node'). Values are COPIED from the Python manifest so both legs are read on one scale; they are NOT measured Node numbers and the Node workload is not the Python one (the Node SDK triages one email per call with a heuristic short-circuit, the Python agent triages a batch in a single tool call), so a direct bar-for-bar comparison is only meaningful with --force-llm-classify. 'enforce' ships false for the same reason the Python perf manifest does: the bars are uncalibrated and TTFT is cold-start dominated. Re-measure before enforcing.
_gating: ttft_max_s, throughput_min_tps, pipeline_max_s, peak_memory_max_gb are GATING bars when enforced. NPU utilization is REPORTED-ONLY (no bar).
